1.title: Add clamp(x, lo, hi) to mathlib
1.body:
Closes https://github.com/o/r/issues/23

How each expect line is met:
- **math.js exports clamp(x, lo, hi), which returns x limited to the range lo to hi**: new `clamp` in math.js returns lo when x < lo, hi when x > hi, else x (bounds inclusive); added to `module.exports` alongside add, subtract, multiply.
- **clamp throws a RangeError when lo is greater than hi**: clamp checks `lo > hi` first and throws `RangeError` naming both values.
- **README.md documents every function math.js exports**: added `### subtract(a, b)` (previously undocumented) and `### clamp(x, lo, hi)` entries; exports are add, subtract, multiply, clamp and each has a heading.
- **npm test passes**: tests added in test/math.test.js for below/above/inside range, each bound, lo == hi, and the RangeError; `npm test` passes 5/5.
